later_events.mechanism: restatement of section 4(b) of EO 12369 by EO 12447 (signed 1983-10-27; 48 FR 50055, Federal Register of October 31, 1983; no effective-date wording, read as effective on signing), recorded as a later event and not an end under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments: section 4(b) of EO 12369, as amended, is further amended to read that the Committee shall terminate on December 31, 1983, unless sooner extended. Before: the sentence installed by this order reads that the Committee shall terminate on October 30, 1983, unless sooner extended. After: the sentence reads that the Committee shall terminate on December 31, 1983, unless sooner extended. The rewrite replaces the whole sentence and changes its substance (the termination date).

restatement of section 4(b) of EO 12369 by EO 12455 (signed 1983-12-29; 49 FR 345, Federal Register of January 4, 1984; no effective-date wording, read as effective on signing), recorded as a later event and not an end under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments: section 4(b) of EO 12369, as amended, is further amended to read that the Committee shall terminate on January 31, 1984, unless sooner extended. Before: the sentence as restated by EO 12447 reads that the Committee shall terminate on December 31, 1983, unless sooner extended. After: the sentence reads that the Committee shall terminate on January 31, 1984, unless sooner extended. The rewrite replaces the whole sentence and changes its substance (the termination date).

clauses.reason: The sole paragraph, in order to extend the life of the President's Private Sector Survey on Cost Control in the Federal Government, restates section 4(b) of Executive Order 12369, as amended, so that the Committee terminates on October 30, 1983, unless sooner extended. The same sentence was rewritten by EO 12447 (signed 1983-10-27, December 31, 1983) and EO 12455 (signed 1983-12-29, January 31, 1984); both are recorded as later events that change the date and are not ends of this clause. The last held sunset is 1984-01-31 ("unless sooner extended", EO 12455); no held source shows whether the Committee was extended again or the date on which it in fact ceased, although EO 12534 lists its establishing order among committees that have terminated or been abolished by statute or whose work is completed. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 orders that the listed Executive Orders, "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" and lists the number 12429 in the No. column of its revocation table (offset 27022 of the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt). This is an express revocation that names this order. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the first-end date is its signing date, 1986-02-25; that is a reading of the text, not express wording, and the Federal Register publication date 1986-03-03 and filing date 1986-02-26 are not effective dates. EO 12534 (signed 1985-09-30; held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt, sha256 2f7a5c13126573ec9fb7f10631df9e25cac3065f405355c469a0222363ab443c) revokes, in section 3(b), Executive Order No. 12369 establishing the President's Private Sector Survey on Cost Control in the Federal Government, among orders that established committees that have terminated or been abolished by statute or whose work is completed; its section 5 reads "Sec. 5 This Order shall be effective September 30,1985." It names the parent order (without the words as amended) but not this amending order, so under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments it is a disclosed earlier candidate end (1985-09-30), not the end.

Bounded search: the dossier's three machine searches, chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no coverage warning (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts); the Cruden by-number scan of held order texts in the packet's LOOKUPS.md; full reads of EO 12553, EO 12447, EO 12455 and EO 12534 in their held FR texts. Under the owner rulings of 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-28 the end is EO 12553, the later sunset amendments are later events, and the parent revocation and the last held sunset are disclosed.
